prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency for every organization — the right choice depends on what you need (services, budget, scale, outcomes, regulatory experience). I can help you find the best fit for your situation. A few quick questions so I can recommend agencies that match you:

- What type of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, physician practice, clinic, dental, med device, pharma, telehealth, behavioral health, payer, etc.)
- Which services do you need? (brand strategy, digital/SEO, paid media, content, PR, physician recruitment, patient acquisition, CRM/email, marketing automation, UX/website, creative/video)
- Are you focused on local (St. Louis metro) audiences or regional/national campaigns?
- Rough annual marketing budget or monthly retainer range?
- Any regulatory/compliance needs (HIPAA, FDA, state-specific rules)?
- Timeline or specific goals/KPIs (patient volume, leads, awareness, ROI)?

If you want immediate help, I can:
- Provide a short list of St. Louis-area agencies with healthcare experience (and what each is strongest at).
- Draft an RFP or list of interview questions and a scoring rubric so you can compare finalists.
- Create a sample campaign plan and estimated budget for your situation.

Also, quick checklist to evaluate agencies right away:
- Relevant healthcare case studies and measurable outcomes (CPL, conversion, ROI, new patients)
- Experience with HIPAA/FDA/compliance where required
- Team experience and senior-level involvement (who will run your account)
- Proven local market knowledge (if you need local patient acquisition)
- Tech stack compatibility (EHR/CRM integration, analytics, marketing automation)
- Transparent pricing and clear deliverables
- References from similar clients
- Reporting cadence and KPIs

Tell me the answers to the questions above (or say which option you want) and I’ll build a tailored shortlist and next steps.
